note: Kela-subsidised routes. Kela pays a share; the person pays an omavastuu. The cost note must state that plainly — 'subsidised' on its own tells nobody what they will pay. PROVISIONAL until clinician sign-off.

entries.note: Requires three months of treatment contact and a psychiatrist's statement. The omavastuu figure in the cost note is a typical range and MUST be confirmed against Kela's current rates before launch. Role is 'care': this is the therapy itself, subsidised — the application process is how you reach it, not what it is.
